commit 3797506b332aa451916edf0f679e3c8fed1efd37
Author:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Mar 24 11:18:01 2026 +0100
Commit:     Justin Tracey <jtracey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Mar 24 11:18:01 2026 +0100

    Bug 2025579 - Ensure offline_access is in OAuth scope for all MS token endpoints. r=edicharry
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D289363

diff --git a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
index 8f9f645276f..b5380152c02 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
+++ b/mailnews/base/src/OAuth2.sys.mjs
@@ -372,8 +372,9 @@ OAuth2.prototype = {
 
           // If we are dealing with Microsoft, and offline_access is missing, add it to the check
           if (
-            this.tokenEndpoint ==
-              "https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/oauth2/v2.0/token" &&
+            this.tokenEndpoint.startsWith(
+              "https://login.microsoftonline.com/"
+            ) &&
             !returnedScopes.includes("offline_access")
           ) {
             returnedScopes.push("offline_access");
title: Bug 2025579 - Ensure offline_access is in OAuth scope for all MS token endpoints. r=edicharry
